CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real Phase 0 server (apps/server): fetches the real live worldapi city chunk (scene 200, 1054 blocks), verifies real IDUNA connect tickets, spawns a player on the real ground height, ticks real server-authoritative on-foot movement with basic collision. Found and fixed a real bug: http_client.h's shared 8KB response buffer silently truncated the real ~35KB chunk response. Verified live end-to-end via UDP probe. No client yet. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
